name: job-dashboard
description: Multi-profile job scraper, matcher & dashboard with Claude-powered CV/cover letter generation

scripts.postinstall: node -e "try { require('child_process').execSync('npx puppeteer browsers install chrome', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch (e) { console.warn('[postinstall] Chrome download failed (non-fatal — run `npx puppeteer browsers install chrome` manually before generating PDFs).'); }"
